description: List every country/region present in the Servicialo network. Combines countries declared by registered nodes with regions observed in operational telemetry over the last 30 days. Use this when an agent needs to know "where is this protocol active?" before issuing a region-scoped query. Returns: array of { code, org_count, event_count_30d } sorted by activity. Codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
name: registry_list_regions
